The '''Model 70 spread barrel''' was a model of [[Spread barrel/Legends|spread barrel]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and sold for 1725 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The attachment was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The barrel was only compatible with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]].
